clips.title: The story
paras: Scout Riell sends the People's Militia after Red Silk Bandanas in the Deadmines. Their fine weave marks the Defias leaders who direct the uprising in Westfall.

Scout Riell and the People's Militia have learned that cloth marks rank in the Defias Brotherhood. Common cutpurses and highwaymen across Westfall tie coarse red cloth over their faces. Senior conspirators and inner-circle operatives wear fine red silk. Bringing back their bandanas strikes at the experienced officers coordinating Edwin VanCleef's uprising.

The senior outlaws gather deep in the Deadmines beneath Moonbrook. Sentinels and scouts outside Sentinel Hill depend on freelance champions to enter the contested tunnels. Each silk bandana recovered means one fewer lieutenant organizing ambushes, guarding weapon caches, or enforcing VanCleef's rule across Westfall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It's no secret that the trademark of the Defias Gang is their Red Bandanas. But we've learned that the material from which these bandanas are made signifies the member's rank.

That being said, I want you to eliminate as many high ranking Defias members as you can. The highest ranking members will undoubtedly be found in VanCleef's secret hideout. When you're done bring me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof of their deaths and I will reward you. Good luck, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been reclaiming our land from the Defias gang? If so show me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend! On behalf of The People's Militia I salute you for your efforts. Soon we will return this land to the people with help from brave souls like you.
